verdict.rationale: Tavily documents an official `tvly` CLI with search, extract, crawl and research subcommands (tavily-docs-38). It supports browser-based `tvly login` OAuth authentication (tavily-docs-55, tavily-docs-57), and installing it also installs Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex (tavily-docs-56), so it clearly delivers an AI-native official CLI. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference page with install instructions and full flag documentation (the evidence comes only from llms.txt snippets), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the official CLI (the community mention describes a user's own wrapper CLI, not Tavily's).
